entities.name: Bromo-fluoro-nitrobenzene
observations: Database-standardized structure: O=[N+]([O-])c1cccc(F)c1Br; an aromatic nitro compound bearing Br and F substituents.

entities.name: NiCl2-NaBH4 reduction
observations: Methanol, water, NiCl2, NaBH4, and sodium ion are used for reduction of the aryl nitro group.

entities.name: Bromo-fluoroaniline
observations: Major product structure: Nc1cccc(F)c1Br; formed by reducing the aryl nitro group to an amino group while retaining aryl Br and F.
